layers.UNICA_ONCHAIN: enforced by UNICA v4 contracts (registry, factory, hook, executor) on every call
layers.UNISWAP_V4_ONCHAIN: enforced by Uniswap v4's PoolManager or the hook callback contract
layers.ENSV2_ONCHAIN: enforced by the ENSv2 registry / permissioned resolver access control (locally: the EAC-compatible fixture)
layers.CHAINLINK_ORACLE: enforced by the pinned price adapter reading the feed (locally: the real adapter over fixture feeds)
layers.CRE_REPORT_VERIFICATION: enforced by the policy receiver on a delivered report (locally: a fixture report, NOT A DON REPORT)
layers.BACKEND_POLICY: enforced by an off-chain or wrapper component (order admission) before an order exists; never a settlement invariant
layers.GRAPH_EVIDENCE: a decision of the evidence projection or subgraph; authenticates, never authorizes
layers.CLIENT_VERIFICATION: a display or approval rule of the POS / wallet client
layers.OPERATOR_RULE: a deployment-script, manifest or runbook refusal; never an on-chain invariant
layers.LOCAL_FIXTURE_ONLY: true only of the local Anvil fixture; not a property of any public deployment

rules.mechanism: addr record of the merchant node under the merchant's own access control; resolved once at admission and frozen into the order's recipient
rules.note: ENS proves control of a name, never payment; the executor stores the recipient and never re-reads a name

rules.rule: Merchant payout binding (an order pays its recipient and no one else)
rules.mechanism: Order.recipient written once by createOrder; take() pays order.recipient only; ReservedRecipient refuses path contracts

rules.rule: Payer binding (only the named payer can pay)
rules.mechanism: pay requires msg.sender == order.payer, else WrongPayer(orderId, payer, caller); payer is never zero

rules.rule: Terminal creation (who may add a terminal subname)
rules.mechanism: register requires SET_SUBREGISTRY at the parent node; a terminal operator holds only SET_TEXT at one per-key resource
rules.note: an invariant of the identity registry, not of settlement

rules.mechanism: authorizeTextRoles(node, key, operator, false) removes the per-key role; status text set to 'revoked'

rules.rule: New-order admission (a terminal may request a new order)
rules.mechanism: TerminalAdmission checks hasRoles(textResource(terminal, com.unica.terminal-status), SET_TEXT, operator) and the status text at admission time, then calls createOrder as the registry-allowlisted creator
rules.note: the executor enforces only that the CREATOR is allowlisted; which terminal is behind the creator is admission policy

rules.mechanism: an order holds no reference to ENS; revocation changes nothing in executor storage; the order stays payable until its deadline
rules.note: revocation never invalidates an existing order; it prevents new admissions

rules.mechanism: factory.createMarket → registry.register recomputes marketId = keccak256(chainid, registry, asset, payout, version, adapter, feedId) and requires equality; hook code hash pinned; hook bits 0x20C0; reverse maps write-once
registry.pause by ADMIN or PAUSER; createOrder and pay require ACTIVE (MarketNotActive)
registry.retire by ADMIN; RETIRED has no exit; a relist is a new version, id, hook, executor and pool
(adapter, feedId) committed into marketId; IUnicaOracleRoute.feedIdFor(asset, payout) == policy.feedId checked at register and in every afterSwap (OracleFeedMismatch)
updatedAt from the source; hook refuses updatedAt > now, == now, and now − updatedAt > maxAge (≤ 300 s ceiling); adapter refuses zero/negative answers and stale rounds
hook refuses produced < minOut (OutputBelowMinimum); executor refuses recipient delta < minOut (RecipientShort) and != out (DeliveryNotExact); oracle band refuses execution outside ±maxDeviationBps
minOut ≤ maxPerTxPayout at createOrder (OrderAboveCap); measured delivery ≤ maxPerTxPayout at pay (PaymentAboveCap)
payoutUsedOnDay[timestamp / 86400] + out ≤ maxPerDayPayout (DailyCapExceeded); per market version
rules.note: a same-day retire-and-relist starts a fresh counter (ruling V4); tooling must refuse deliberate same-day cap evasion — that refusal is an OPERATOR_RULE

rules.rule: Aggregate seed cap ($100 per registry and chain)
rules.mechanism: deployment script enumerates marketCount/getMarkets, sums maxSeedPayout over non-RETIRED markets plus the proposed one, refuses above the cap (ruling V3, S5)
rules.note: never described as enforced on-chain; the per-market seed cap IS on-chain (SeedAboveCap at markSeeded)

rules.rule: Liquidity reseeding restriction (never reseed, widen or recenter a live market)
rules.mechanism: no tool adds liquidity at or after SEEDED; ruling V2 keeps the hook flag set unchanged (no beforeAddLiquidity)

one transaction: pull exact input, swap through the market pool, settle, take to recipient, verify receipt count, delivery and residuals, account caps, emit Settled last; any failure reverts everything
registry → market → hook emitter → executor emitter → pool key → paired events in one transaction → finality; UNKNOWN fails closed
rules.note: evidence authenticates provenance; it never authorizes or settles

rules.mechanism: the client accepts only the manifest's identity contract; mint requires namespace control of the node and namehash(name) == node; tokenURI reads only immutable data
rules.note: proves identity-art provenance only; never current name control, payment, status or endorsement

rules.mechanism: receiver records an admission only for a forwarder-delivered report whose every binding matches (chain, receiver, release, registry, market version, workflow, expiry, nonce); the admission wrapper requires literal equality of order terms
rules.note: optional per market; ordinary v4 settlement never depends on it; forwarder success is not delivery

rules.mechanism: PAID only when the evidence decision is VERIFIED for the expected order id; a hash, a Swap-shaped log, ReportProcessed(true), an NFT, an ENS resolution or a graph answer without provenance never shows PAID
manifest environment LOCAL_ANVIL_NO_VALUE; fixture feeds described as FIXTURE; SVG carries SEPOLIA TESTNET / ENSv2 BETA — NO VALUE; the client always shows the label
